body_html: @politico #politics #corruption Only in Congress can you not do your job, get almost 100% job security, and then vote to give yourself a raise. Seriously I ask you to list the accomplishments of 114th congress. What landmark legislation has been passed or repealed? Beyond the doc fix, not much. Highway funding? Nope. Repeal or renewal of Patriot Act? Nope. Renewal of ESEA which expired in 2007. Goose egg there too. I have a novel idea. Before you can ask for a raise you have to actually do your job.
